title: Dexcom Follow Upload
body: Would it be possible to include carbs and insulin treatments in the Dexcom Follow upload? Although they can't be tracked in Follow, I think this information could be utilized in sugarmate.io

comments.body:
Dexcom Share does not seem to have an API to post data events for carbs, insulin, etc.

[Dexcom Share API](https://github.com/nightscout/share2nightscout-bridge/issues/15)
